terbaru.judul: Twitter Sentiment Analysis: How To Hedge Your Bets In The Stock Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a novel way to make use of market monitoring elements derived from public mood to retain a portfolio within limited risk state (highly improved hedging bets) during typical market conditions.

terbaru.judul: High Frequency Trading and Mini Flash Crashes
terbaru.pelajaran: In contrast to previous studies, we find that Mini Flash Crashes are the result of regulation framework and market fragmentation, in particular due to the aggressive use of Intermarket Sweep Orders and Regulation NMS protecting only Top of the Book.

terbaru.judul: High-Frequency Trading Synchronizes Prices in Financial Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, I use data from NASDAQ to show that HFT synchronizes prices in financial markets, making the values of related securities change contemporaneously.
